- `len(&self) -> usize` runs pending tasks (so the count is accurate) and returns `entry_count()` as `usize` — 0 for a fresh cache.
- Also added `is_empty` to satisfy the standard clippy lint that accompanies `len`.

It's reachable at `crate::tree::cached_state::AccountStorageCache` within the crate (the "unreachable pub" warnings are only because the module isn't re-exported outside the crate; in-crate paths, which the test patches use, resolve fine). No files under `tests/` were touched.
